messages:
Matt K: Heads up — nightly invoicer produced inflated support fees for ~120 customers. Noticed doubled support line on many mid-size accounts, amounts look like 2x of expected. Filing initial slack thread so we have a record. :eyes:
Sarah B: ugh. which job ran? nightly-invoice-run or rerun_retry?
Matt K: nightly-invoice-run (cron). billing-bot reported batch completed but there were warnings. link to batch id below.
billing-bot: Invoice batch 2026-03-21-03 completed with warnings. batch_id=nb-20260321-03 warnings=SUPPORT_PRORATE_MISMATCH
Jonah L: can you paste a sample invoice JSON? the warning code suggests a proration mismatch.
Matt K: sure — sample from acct 98765: `"lines": [{"code":"compute","amount":1200},{"code":"support","amount":180},{"code":"support","amount":180}]` — support appears twice, both prorated to full month rather than split.
Sarah B: that looks like the proration merge step duplicated support when daylight-saving tz shift hit the proration window. we pushed billing-service v2.3.1 last week — Sarah to check PRs touching proration merge.
Jonah L: attaching logs from invoice worker (snippet):
```
2026-03-21T03:00:12Z invoice-worker INFO starting batch nb-20260321-03
2026-03-21T03:00:15Z billing-service WARN proration: window start 2026-03-08T00:00:00-08:00 end 2026-03-08T02:00:00-07:00
2026-03-21T03:00:16Z billing-service ERROR proration: merge conflict detected for support plan id=SUP-STD account=98765
2026-03-21T03:00:16Z invoice-worker INFO applied line merge: count_before=1 count_after=2
```
Jonah L: that middle line shows tz offset mismatch — two different offsets caused the merge routine to treat the same proration slice as distinct. looks like recent change to convert times to local zones in memory caused this.
Sarah B: oh right, I remember toggling localize_timestamps in proration module (commit bad3f7e). I thought it only affected logs. will open revert PR immediately.
Emma R: any customer-facing exposure? I have a CS pg with 3 customers flagged already complaining about doubled fees.
Matt K: initial scan: ~120 accounts, mostly on monthly support plans with proration around Mar 8. some invoices duplicated support line, some had one support line but amount doubled.
Sarah B: mitigation plan: 1) block nightly-invoice-run (hold next runs) 2) revert localize_timestamps in proration module (PR created) 3) re-run batch with idempotent merge path enabled 4) generate credits for impacted invoices and trigger refunds where payment already taken.
Jonah L: I'll stop the cron and snapshot current S3 output. also recommend re-running in dry-run mode then a small reissue for a subset (10 accounts) to validate.
Matt K: filing BILL-4312 for the remediation + customer outreach. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-4312
Sarah B: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood/billing-service/pull/3896 (revert localize_timestamps). adding test for DST boundary proration.
Emma R: I'll draft customer emails for impacted tier B customers and coordinate refunds with ops. please ping me when we have final list.
Matt K: assigning: Sarah (fix + tests), Jonah (hold & rerun infra), Emma (cs comms + refunds), Matt (finance reconciliation). target: re-run dry on 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC and full reissue 2026-03-21 12:00 UTC if green.
Sarah B: noted. will update PR and post results here. :white_check_mark:
Jonah L: cron stopped and S3 snapshot created: s3://redwood-billing/dumps/nb-20260321-03-snapshot.json
Matt K: thanks everyone. keep updates tight — high priority for finance close.
Emma R: copied support leads and prepared initial outreach template. will await final impacted list.
Sarah B: quick note — if any invoices already emailed, we'll need to mark them 'revised' before sending credits to avoid duplicate-charge confusion.
Matt K: agreed. adding that to BILL-4312 checklist.
